purpose: Round 02: accepted reference C wood and light, sparse private room, compare degree of stylization/cartoon with magic.

references.role: Accepted photo C: only wood palette, window daylight, domestic intimacy.

prompts.quiet-enchantment:
Create a production-quality visual concept for the primary screen of StoryOS's magical PRIVATE WRITER'S ROOM. Target dimensions 1440 x 1024. One image, one full desktop-app viewport, no montage and no browser chrome. This is a CONTROLLED STYLE STUDY: the user has already accepted the function and is choosing how much stylization/cartoon to use. Read the constraints carefully.

User's strongest priorities: SPARSE ELEMENTS, strong visual hierarchy and negative space, a small personal room used in everyday life, warm dark wood and window daylight, recognizably MAGICAL and artistically stylized rather than a photograph. The previous designs failed because they looked like ornate ceremonial halls with too many props. Make a small comfortable domestic room, modest normal ceiling height, quiet simple furniture, room to breathe. The magical quality should be in one charming action, not in many ornate decorations.

REFERENCE IMAGES:
Image 1 is the exact photo the user liked: Kipling's study at Bateman's. Borrow ONLY its rich muted warm oak/walnut brown wood, slightly olive-brown shadows, soft daylight from an ordinary rectangular window, convincing bounced light, and intimate inhabited feeling. Radically simplify its crowded shelves and numerous objects. It is NOT a layout to clone, NOT a photorealism requirement.
Image 2 is the existing StoryOS editor. Borrow ONLY restrained readable Chinese typography for the very few flat UI controls. It is NOT the room, and do not show an editor, chat or three-column layout.

SPACE AND COMPOSITION:
Standing eye height from the doorway into a modest room about 5.5m by 6m. Simple heavy timber ceiling beams at normal domestic height. Plain muted warm plaster on upper walls, warm dark oak paneling below, matte dark wood floor with broad quiet grain. Window is near the back-right with soft green garden outside and calm daytime light crossing the room. No Gothic arch, rose window, castle stone columns, dome, ceremonial altar or giant hall.
Exactly five simple modest wooden angled book-display stands distributed naturally along the side and back walls, asymmetrically like furniture, NOT a horseshoe ritual arrangement; three carry one deep green/burgundy/navy closed project book each, two empty. Stand designs are slender and practical, no carved plinths, no pedestals with sculpture. They must fit in the quiet background without becoming a row of dominant objects.
The central creation surface is an everyday small wooden writing table, simple construction with open space underneath. A tiny hovering blank book or three luminous blank pages and a quill, only 15cm above the table, create the one magical focal event; a short delicate trail of warm-gold sparks, very local. One ordinary chair at the table and one comfortable green reading chair in a corner are sufficient domestic context. One modest plain rug if helpful, no ornate all-over carpet. At least a third of the image should be quiet open floor or unornamented wall. Clear walkable floor, relaxed non-symmetrical arrangement, allow furniture to have empty space around it.
Only project books, table/quill, chairs and one small desk lamp as props. No mass bookcases, stacks of random books, globes, orreries, chandeliers, candles everywhere, banners, framed portrait galleries, piles of scrolls, plants everywhere, magic rune carpets, stained glass, or constant light beams. Sparse does not mean blank greybox: achieve beauty through designed shapes, wood tones, light, high-quality art and careful composition.

UI, IDENTICAL AND MINIMAL:
Tiny warm-ivory 'StoryOS' top-left. Top-right a quiet '全部作品' with '⌘ K'. Bottom-left one concise warm-ivory '继续写作' button and book title '星海余烬'. Small '新建故事' label by the central table. At most these four areas, 40px edge margins, no card grids, statistics, sidebar, inventory, extra copy or huge promotional headline. Typography is crisply typeset, 14-16px body equivalent, one serif and one sans serif maximum. No people, hands, FPS crosshairs, masks, devices or labels naming the concept.
Preserve the chosen dark wood and gentle window daylight in every style; avoid orange wash, black crushed shadows, oversaturation or purple/blue neon. The final scene must feel like a personal space one would inhabit, with a little magic that feels at home there.
Direction name: Quiet Enchantment. ART TREATMENT: mildly stylized tactile 3D, a tasteful cozy adventure game environment. Grounded perspective and physically convincing daylight, but simplify materials and soften silhouettes. Wood grain is broad and art-directed, not photographic noise. Furniture edges gently softened, books slightly expressive in proportions. Fine crafted shapes, clean areas of restful color, warm contact shadows. Recognizably a made world with quiet everyday magic, not a real room photographed. Gentle magical shimmer around the floating paper is warm-white gold. Keep stylization subtle but visible, no cartoon outlines, no plastic or clay gloss.

Confident broad painted shapes, warm dark walnut and muted olive, soft painterly shadow gradients. Simplified carved-by-hand furniture contours with slightly playful asymmetry. Deliberate brush texture across wood and plaster instead of fine realistic grain. Strong coherent volumetric room depth and eye-height camera, not a flat illustration or isometric dollhouse. The light has a soft watercolor/gouache quality while geometry remains readable and substantial. Slightly enlarged book corners and quill provide charm. Sparse golden hand-painted wisps curl around the few floating pages. Mature literary, cozy and magical; not childish, no comic linework or crowded fantasy symbols.
prompts.soft-fable:
CRITICAL ART DIRECTION: This image must be CLEARLY CARTOON-STYLIZED 3D, visibly different from architectural photography. Think a mature, beautifully art-directed animated family film environment. Visibly hand-painted wood with just a few broad grain strokes, smooth broad color surfaces, charming rounded thick book covers, subtly exaggerated bowed furniture legs and thick softened timber joints. No photoreal fabric fibers, no gritty detailed plaster, no individual fine floorboard scratches. Leaves outside window are painterly soft color shapes. The window casts broad beautifully simplified soft light shapes. Keep the warm deep BROWN WOOD and window LIGHT of the source PHOTO, but discard the photo's rendering style. Rich dark walnut palette, muted moss green chair, soft cream walls; restrained golden magic. This deliberate CARTOON treatment takes priority over any language that might imply photorealism below.

observations_before_final_generation: First two results remained close to realism. Strengthen cartoon styling of the third while preserving wood, light, density and functions.
